name: Rotting Hex
description: The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (2d6 + 4) necrotic damage. On a successful save, a creature takes no damage. If the target moves closer to the creature on the target’s next turn, the target takes an additional 7 (1d6 + 4) necrotic damage.
